item.title: Labs
item.description:
Lab Rules and Safety (PDF)

The first four weeks of lab are dedicated to exploring the Arduino board and specific topics necessary for designing autonomous robots. All lab sessions after that are free time for groups to work on their final projects.

TOPICS SLIDES HANDOUTS FILES
Lab 1: Lab introduction and safety, Arduino microprocessor (PDF) (PDF)  
Lab 2: Sensors and signals, A/D, D/A, PWM (PDF - 1.6MB) (PDF)  
Lab 3: GPS and data logging (PDF) (PDF) (ZIP) (This ZIP file contains: 2 .pde files and 1 .m file.)
